messages:
maria: FYI during the canary this morning the geo DNS bounced traffic from us-west to eu-west after only 3 probe failures. saw a 150ms tail latency spike for some sessions. not a full outage but enough to surface in our dashboards :grimacing:
eli: ouch. do we have the probe logs? were the failures transient (network blips) or real backend 5xx?
nate: logs show backend 503s for ~12s across two instances during the deploy window, but health checks were aggressive: `failure_threshold=3` and `probe_interval=4s` so it flipped pretty fast.
maria: exact. summary: rolling update + noisy host + tight window = premature cross-region failover. we should avoid switching regions for short blips or during known rolling jobs.
satya: proposal: introduce a graceful_failover_delay param and a probe_window smoothing. e.g. require failures for X seconds OR revert to local sticky fallback before global failover.
eli: agree. also add a weighted latency penalty so we don't prefer eu-west if it increases p99.
nate: here's a simple config sketch we tested in staging:
```
geo_failover:
  failure_threshold: 5       # increase from 3 to 5
  probe_interval: 5s
  graceful_failover_delay: 30s  # wait before full region switch
  prefer_local_sticky: true
  sticky_duration: 300s
```
maria: sounds good. also want an escape hatch: if the canary tag is present, extend grace period automatically. exception helps during deploys.
eli: can we simulate this quickly with our traffic replay harness? i'd like to validate no regressions to cost or latency.
satya: i'll run a chaos sim: create transient 10s backend error, see if the new rules keep traffic local and only fallback after 30s. will post results.
ops-runbook-bot: runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/geo-failover#graceful-delay (added recommended defaults) :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks — also add a Prometheus alert for "geo-failover-count" spike so oncall knows when regions are flipping unusually.
nate: +1, and add metric for "graceful_delay_skipped" when forced by config.
deploy-bot: rollout note: will stage config to canary pool at 12:30 UTC, full roll at 13:00 if stable.
satya: sim results: with graceful_failover_delay=30s we stayed on origin for 12s transient and only fell back after sustained 34s failures. latency p99 stayed within SLO. posting graphs in #infra-dashboards.
maria: perfect. can we also add a small backstop that prevents failing to any region beyond a latency threshold (eg do not failover to region if median RTT > 120ms)?
eli: yes — fallback_policy should be aware of RTT and cost. i'll open a PR with probe-window + rtt gating + canary override.
maria: great. assign to @eli, @nate for review. thanks everyone. :rocket:
